annotations.title: Edit a bought domain's email forwarding

description: Email forwarding on a domain bought through handoff: mail to box@domain is forwarded to an address you choose. list, add (box and to) or delete (box). The first forward makes the registrar publish its own MX and SPF records; if the domain already has other MX records the answer says so (mx_conflict), because mail goes to whichever MX the sender picks.

action.description: list the forwards, add one, or delete one

agent_id.description: The agent that owns the domain — you must control it

box.description: add/delete: the part before @, e.g. hello

to.description: add: the address mail is forwarded to

name: domain_email
title: Edit a bought domain's email forwarding
